design.dataTableControlsHint: Each cell holds a switch of its own: the keyboard goes from switch to switch, and the table scrolls to each.
design.dateFieldHint: Three fields of digits, never a wheel
design.chatText: Message bubbles, a row of the chat list, a day divider, a conversation's title, the composer and the new-messages pill.
design.chatImmersive: On a phone, a conversation hides the tab bar, and the composer takes its place.
design.chatClosedText: When nobody can write, a line in the composer's place says why. When that happens while writing, the keyboard moves to the line, and a screen reader elsewhere hears it. Here, sending closes the chat.
design.chatSample1: Good morning. The supplier comes at 10:00, can someone meet them?
design.chatSample2: I'm already here, I'll meet them
design.chatSample3: The technician's details are here: https://www.example.com/service
design.chatSample5:
For tomorrow:
Check the second fridge
Order lemons
Close the till by 23:00
design.chatSample6: I'll be there in ten minutes
design.chatSample7: Can I swap Friday with you?
design.chatAnnounceText: A message from management is pinned to the top of its group, with "I've read it" for everyone it asks, and for its author and management how many did. While it waits for the reader it stays under the title.
design.chatAnnounceSample: From next week the till closes at 22:00
design.chatAuthorView: As its author and management see it
design.chatActionsText: Tapping a message, or the button beside it on a computer, opens what can be done with it. After deleting or removing one, "Undo" stays for 10 seconds. A screen reader hears on the button whose message it is, when it was sent and how it starts.
design.chatComposerAnnounce: Management's composer in a group, with the switch for a message from management
design.chatPicturesText: Photos in chat: the thumbnail in a message, which opens whole in a sheet, a photo on its way, and a file no longer kept. The message itself stays.
design.chatPictureSample: This is how the kitchen looks now
design.chatAttachText: The attach button opens a sheet with a photo or a PDF. A chosen photo is made ready on the phone and shows over the field, and so does a PDF, with its name and size. In a demo business the button says nothing can be attached.
design.chatPdfText: PDFs in chat: the file in a message, which opens once downloaded, a file on its way with how much of it went and a way to stop, a file that wasn't sent, and a file no longer kept. The message itself stays. In a conversation's details the files are in one card, a row for each.

method.title: How it's worked out
method.hours: Each shift counts by the hours the clock recorded, to the minute. An unpaid break comes off.
method.day: On a workday the first hours are regular: up to <ltr>8</ltr> in a 6-day week, <ltr>8.6</ltr> in a 5-day week, and <ltr>7</ltr> on the eve of Shabbat or a holiday and on a night shift. The next two hours are overtime at 125%, and the rest at 150%.
method.week: Past <ltr>42</ltr> hours a week, regular hours count as overtime too.

storefront.name: Public page
storefront.description: Hours, address and a booking link

notifications.name: Notifications
notifications.description: Notifications in the app and on the phone, and reminders for the team

availabilityReminderHours.label: Reminder to send availability
availabilityReminderHours.hint: How long before it is due to remind whoever has not sent availability. When it is due, owners and managers see how many still have not. With no reminder, neither is sent.

clockOutReminderMinutes.label: Reminder to clock out
clockOutReminderMinutes.hint: How long after the end of their shift to remind whoever is still clocked in. With no shift in the schedule, after 12 hours. After 24 hours, whoever approves hours here is told either way.

lists.name: Lists
lists.description: Opening, closing, cleaning and orders between departments

remindBeforeMinutes.label: Reminder before it's due
remindBeforeMinutes.hint: The people a list is for get a reminder this long before it's due.

lateAfterMinutes.label: When a list is late
lateAfterMinutes.hint: A list not finished by its time counts as late this long after it.

tellManagersWhenLate.label: Tell whoever edits the lists when one is late
tellManagersWhenLate.hint: The owners and whoever edits the lists hear when a list is late.

tellOwnersAfterMinutes.label: Tell the owners when a list is still late
tellOwnersAfterMinutes.hint: The owners are told when a list that opens by itself at its times is still open this long after it became late.

tellWhenFinished.label: Tell when a list is finished
tellWhenFinished.hint: Whoever sent a list, and the department that asked for it, hear when it's finished.

fixHours.label: How long a closed list can be fixed
fixHours.hint: For roles given "Fixing closed lists" on Roles and permissions. Whoever edits the lists fixes them at any time.

photoDays.label: How long photos are kept
photoDays.hint: Photos on lists are deleted this long after the day they were taken. The item stays done.

chat.name: Chat
chat.description: A group for the whole team and each department, and private chats

teamGroupWho.label: Who writes in the whole team's group
teamGroupWho.hint: When only management writes, everyone else reads and confirms they read.

fileDays.label: How long chat files are kept
fileDays.hint: Photos and files are deleted after this time. The messages themselves stay.

fileSpaceMb.label: Space for chat files
fileSpaceMb.hint: When the space runs out, the oldest files are deleted first. If someone sent more than half of it, their oldest go first.

documentSpaceMb.label: Space for documents
documentSpaceMb.hint: When the space runs out, no new documents are sent. Documents are never deleted for space.

order_taking.name: Taking orders
order_taking.description: Take orders and send them to be prepared

takerDepartments.label: Departments that take orders
takerDepartments.hint: People in these departments take orders. Those who run the menu and owners do too.

onlyOnTheClock.label: Take orders only during a shift
onlyOnTheClock.hint: Orders can be sent from clocking in until half an hour after clocking out. A shift open for more than 16 hours doesn't count. Owners always can.

takeBackMinutes.label: How long the sender can take an item back
takeBackMinutes.hint: After that it's cancelled with a reason, and the cancel shows in the activity log.

lateAfterMinutes.label: When an order has waited too long
lateAfterMinutes.hint: An order not ready this long after it was sent is marked as waiting.

dayEndsAt.label: When the business day ends
dayEndsAt.hint: Orders after midnight up to this time belong to the day before, takeaway numbers included.

employee_files.name: Employee file
employee_files.description: What the business needs to pay wages: ID, address, bank account and pension. Kept encrypted, and every view is logged.

askBank.label: Ask for a bank account for wages
askBank.hint: Workers add the account themselves, with a code by SMS. Without one, wages are paid some other way.

askAddress.label: Ask for the home address
askAddress.hint: For Form 101 and the notice of working conditions. An approved Form 101 system asks for it too.

askEmergencyContact.label: Ask for an emergency contact
askEmergencyContact.hint: Optional for workers. Managers see it, to call if something happens at work.

askWorkLanguage.label: Ask for a language for work instructions
askWorkLanguage.hint: Optional for workers. So work and safety instructions can be given in a language they understand.

form101.label: Form 101
form101.hint: How workers fill in the form each year. For a link, add the name and the link below too.

options.print: On paper, handed to the business
options.link: In an approved system, by a link

form101Provider.label: Name of the Form 101 system
form101Provider.hint: Workers see it on the button: "Fill in the form at" and this name.

form101Link.label: Link to Form 101
form101Link.hint: A secure address, starting with https, of a system the Tax Authority approved for Form 101. Workers see which site it opens.

payrollProvider.label: Who prepares the payroll
payrollProvider.hint: Shown in the notice to workers as who receives their details. For example: the accountant's office.

employerName.label: Legal name of the employer
employerName.hint: As registered with the Tax Authority. Shown in the notice to workers and on Form 101.

employerPhone.label: Phone for questions about the file
employerPhone.hint: A mobile or a landline. Workers see it in the notice, and it goes on Form 101.

deductionsFile.label: Deductions file number
deductionsFile.hint: 9 digits starting with 9. It goes on Form 101.
